name: modbee-ota
description: Firmware updates for a ModBee node over MQTT, from inside the PLC program: one block, FB_OtaNode, on the MQTT library's FB_MqttClient. The node pulls the new firmware a piece at a time, checks it, switches to it and reboots - and if the new firmware does not come back on MQTT, the board goes back to the old one by itself. The program decides when: accept an update, hold a verified one until the machine is stopped, apply it, or abort. A dropped connection or a power cut resumes where it stopped, so a slow cellular link is not paid for twice. Signing with your own key is one option structure, and the Sparkplug method puts the update on a SCADA host's screens. The flash work runs in the background, so the PLC scan never waits for it.
